verdict.rationale: Aircall's API reference documents per-call endpoints to retrieve a transcription and a summary, along with sentiments and topics. Its marketing says AI Assistants capture notes automatically, so AI-generated summaries and transcripts are tied to calls. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how summaries and transcripts appear in the conversation view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, calls get AI summaries and transcripts attached to the conversation

citations.quote: Retrieve a transcription ... Retrieve sentiments ... Retrieve topics ... Retrieve a summary
